Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Record Class ParameterBindingTransferPlan

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model.ParameterBindingTransferPlan
public record ParameterBindingTransferPlan(ParameterId sourceParameterId, ParameterId targetParameterId, List<ParameterBindingTarget> targets, boolean invertAfterTransfer) extends Record
Immutable model-level plan for transferring selected object bindings between parameters.

The plan has value semantics: targets are copied, non-empty, and distinct; source and target parameter IDs must differ. It describes intent for ParameterBindingBatchOperations.transfer(ParameterBindingTransferPlan) and does not itself mutate model or Editor state.
